name: How much does garage flooring installation cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does garage flooring installation cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest cost drivers are garage size, concrete condition, repair work, and the finish you choose. For a standard two-car garage, professionally installed coatings in the Denver area commonly land in the mid-thousands, with decorative chip designs and extensive prep increasing the price. A detailed on-site estimate is the best way to get an accurate number.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost depends on size, prep, repairs, and coating type. For a typical two-car garage, expect pricing to vary widely based on the floor condition and finish.
